title: XL MIMO Extreme Learning Machines: Wave-Domain Inference with Stacked Metasurfaces
abstract: arXiv:2610.35469v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The recently envisioned goal-oriented communications paradigm requires machine learning inference to be performed directly on wirelessly transferred data, by splitting neural network computations between the transmitter, the Receiver (RX), and the wireless channel. Such approaches aim to offload large portions of the computation onto the channel itself, which is often controlled by reconfigurable MetaSurfaces (MSs). Typical MS-parametrized systems, however, enable only limited computation offloading in the wave domain, usually corresponding to a single neural network layer, due to adverse channel fading effects and the almost linear operation of the channel and conventional MS models. translated_title: 超大规模MIMO极限学习机：利用堆叠超表面进行波域推理
translated_abstract: 近期提出的目标导向通信范式要求直接在无线传输的数据上执行机器学习推理，将神经网络计算分布于发射机、接收机（RX）与无线信道之间。此类方法旨在将大部分计算卸载到信道本身，而信道通常由可重构超表面（MS）控制。然而，典型的超表面参数化系统由于不利的信道衰落效应以及信道与传统超表面模型的近似线性操作，只能在波域实现有限的计算卸载，通常仅对应于单个神经网络层。在本文中，我们证明了一个在接收端配备堆叠智能超表面（SIM）的超大规模（XL）多输入多输出（MIMO）系统，连同单天线及其配套的射频链，可以作为一个两（此处摘要原文被截断）
tldr: 本文提出将接收端配备堆叠智能超表面（SIM）的超大规模（XL）MIMO系统与单天线射频链相结合，作为波域极限学习机，突破传统超表面系统仅能实现单层计算卸载的局限，实现更深层次的神经网络波域推理。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that an XL MIMO system equipped with stacked intelligent metasurfaces at the receiver, together with a single antenna and its RF chain, can act as a wave-domain extreme learning machine, overcoming the single-layer computation offloading limitation of conventional metasurface-parametrized systems.
